pick_hero_deposit: Pick a bot. Enter an amount. Deposit.
est_shares_empty: Enter an amount to preview shares.
deposit_lock: Lock funds and back this bot
deposit_wallet_note: Funds stay in your wallet until you sign. Marketo never holds keys.
backer_profit_1: What your shares are worth minus what you deposited.
backer_profit_2: Shares gain only on realized new profit, above the last peak. Unmatched Yes or No does not count.
backer_profit_3: Any performance fee comes out of that profit first. You keep the rest.
connect_to_sign: Connect wallet to sign this deposit. No transaction is sent until you approve it.
wallet_demo: Demo connect — this client has no chain adapter yet. Nothing is submitted.
wallet_ready: Wallet ready. You still sign every transaction.
no_wallet: No browser wallet found. Install one, then try again.
connect_unavailable: Wallet is busy. Open it and try again.
footer_line: Study the card and back a bot.
enter_note: Creating a bot opens a vault others can deposit into. You still sign every transaction.
enter_fact_1: You become a named bot on the card.
enter_fact_2: You open a vault others can back.
performance_fee_lead: You are paid only when the vault makes new profit. No management, deposit, or withdrawal fee.
performance_fee_rate: 0–20%, locked at create. Opening purse is not profit.
performance_fee_mark: Fee only when share price beats its peak. Flat, down, or climbing back: no fee.
performance_fee_profit: Realized value: idle collateral, venue escrow, and matched Yes + No. An unmatched pile of one side does not count.
performance_fee_pay: Minted as extra vault shares, not taken as cash. 80% goes to the recipient you name; 20% to Marketo. Depositors keep the rest. Fee shares are not opening purse and do not raise the cap.
performance_fee_choose: Set 0 to charge nothing. A fee above 0 needs a recipient.
card_preview_note: As you write, this is how the bot prints.
wallet_same_note: The connected wallet will trade this vault.
wallet_other_note: Enter the address that will trade. You still sign the open-vault transaction.
need_purse_balance: Opening purse cannot exceed your balance.
receipt_line: {name} is on the card. Vault opened.
wrong_network: This wallet is on the wrong network.
open_vault_pending: Waiting for the vault transaction to confirm. The vault is not open yet.
open_vault_approving: Approve the token, then sign open-vault. Nothing is open yet.
open_vault_reverted: The vault transaction reverted. Papers are unchanged.
open_vault_rpc: The network request failed. Nothing was confirmed.
missing_asset_config: Vault asset is not configured. Open vault cannot be sent.
need_valid_operator: Enter a valid bot wallet address.
see_on_card: See this bot on the card
connect_to_open: Connect wallet to sign this open-vault. No transaction is sent until you approve it.
scratched_note: Scratched — this bot is not taking deposits.
purse_full_note: Purse is at max. This bot is not taking deposits.
in_form_empty: No in-form bots on the card. See the program.
withdraw_lock: Redeem capital and PnL from this bot
need_amount_lock: Enter how much to lock into this bot.
need_amount_redeem: Enter how much NAV to redeem from this bot.
redeem_wallet_note: Redeem returns capital and PnL together. You still sign.
connect_to_read: Connect to read your book. Nothing moves until you sign.
connect_to_sign_withdraw: Connect wallet to sign this redeem. No transaction is sent until you approve it.
need_amount_settle: Enter an amount to deposit or withdraw.
need_shares: Not enough shares to redeem that amount.
watch_only_note: You own this vault. You cannot pull depositor funds.
book_empty_backed: No backed bots in this book.
book_empty_mine: No bots of yours in this book.
deposit_approving: Approve the token, then sign deposit. Nothing is locked yet.
deposit_pending: Waiting for the deposit to confirm. Nothing is locked yet.
deposit_confirmed: Deposit confirmed. This bot is on your book.
deposit_reverted: The deposit reverted. Nothing was locked.
deposit_rpc: The network request failed. Nothing was confirmed.
deposit_cap: That amount is above the remaining vault cap.
deposit_not_live: This bot is not a live vault. Nothing was sent.
withdraw_pending: Waiting for the redeem to confirm. Nothing has left the vault yet.
withdraw_confirmed: Redeem confirmed. Your remaining NAV is on the book.
withdraw_reverted: The redeem reverted. Nothing left the vault.
withdraw_rpc: The network request failed. Nothing was confirmed.
withdraw_exceeds: That amount is above the redeemable assets on this bot.
withdraw_not_live: This bot is not a live vault. Nothing was sent.
